# Graph operations · font

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### font.resolve

Select a named font face from the embedded resources of a published graph.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `name` | `string` | Required |  |
| Input | `resources` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `fontResource` | — |  |

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe font.resolve --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### font.stack

Collect named font resources in the order used for face selection.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `names` | `array<string>` | Required | {"items":"string"} |
| Input | `resources` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `array<fontResource>` | — | {"items":"fontResource"} |

Guides: [guide](../font-resources.md#use-text-in-a-material-graph)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe font.stack --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
